decisions.reason: As a clear extension of the firm's web-mapping offer with its own page and several rapid releases, it likely meets or stays close enough to aspirations to justify continued support.
Although it appears more like a niche add-on with weaker public prominence, it is closely related to the core map application business and can be retained while the firm learns about demand.
Its homepage placement and explicit mobile usability improvement suggest strategic relevance and enough promise to keep it on the market for further evaluation.
A GIS solution platform is highly consistent with the firm's long-term direction and core capabilities, so management would likely keep it despite some uncertainty about early results.
Mobile field data capture fits well with enterprise and public-sector geospatial workflows, and the dedicated product presentation indicates sufficient commitment to continue.
As a search-related extension for web map apps with its own page, it is close enough to the established offer that the firm would likely keep it rather than reallocate resources immediately.
